coordinateSystem: meters; x = bow (+), y = port (+); polygon closed implicitly. Entries with floorM: origin = the game model's origin (as hologram release holo-v2), floorM = the model's lowest point below it. Entries without floorM: origin = center of the top-view bounding box (Fleetyards trace)
source: Top views of the ship models from cryon.rocks (Motherlode), extracted from Star Citizen game files (CIG assets): every triangle filled -> closed 0.1 m -> largest outer contour -> Douglas-Peucker max(0.08 m, 0.4 % of length). Entries without floorM: top-view renders from fleetyards.net, traced
